scripts.db:up: docker compose --env-file backend/.env up -d --wait && npm run db:migrate
scripts.tauri: cd frontend && npm run tauri dev
scripts.web:after-backend: npm run wait:backend && npm run web
scripts.tauri:after-backend: npm run wait:backend && npm run tauri
scripts.dev:web: npm run db:up && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,web -c green,magenta "npm run backend" "npm run web:after-backend"
scripts.dev:tauri: npm run db:up && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,tauri -c green,magenta "npm run backend" "npm run tauri:after-backend"
